name: Presidencia de la República de Nicaragua
description: Office of the head of state and government. Daniel Ortega has been president since 10 January 2007; Rosario Murillo vice president since 10 January 2017. A 2025 constitutional amendment allowed the presidency to be exercised by co-presidents.

name: Asamblea Nacional de Nicaragua
description: Unicameral national legislature of Nicaragua (National Assembly).

name: Corte Suprema de Justicia de Nicaragua
aliases: Supreme Court of Justice of Nicaragua
description: Supreme Court of Justice, highest court of Nicaragua; magistrates elected by the National Assembly.

name: Consejo Supremo Electoral
description: Supreme Electoral Council, the branch of government administering elections in Nicaragua.

name: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Nicaragua
description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Nicaragua (has had co-ministers).

name: Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público de Nicaragua
aliases: Ministry of Finance and Public Credit
description: Ministry of Finance and Public Credit of Nicaragua.

name: Ministerio de Salud de Nicaragua
description: Ministry of Health of Nicaragua.

name: Ministerio de Educación de Nicaragua
description: Ministry of Education of Nicaragua.

name: Ministerio del Interior de Nicaragua
description: Ministry of the Interior (Gobernación) of Nicaragua; oversees migration (DGME) and the penitentiary system.

name: Ministerio de Transporte e Infraestructura de Nicaragua
description: Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure of Nicaragua.

name: Ministerio del Ambiente y los Recursos Naturales
description: Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources of Nicaragua.

name: Ministerio de la Vivienda y Asentamientos Humanos
description: Ministry of Housing and Human Settlements of Nicaragua.

name: Ministerio de Energía y Minas
description: Ministry of Energy and Mines of Nicaragua (listed in OAS member-state directory).

name: Ministerio de la Defensa de Nicaragua
description: Ministry of Defense of Nicaragua (cabinet ministry listed in foreign-government directories).

name: Ministerio Público de Nicaragua
description: Public prosecutor's office (Ministerio Público) of Nicaragua.

name: Instituto Nicaragüense de Estudios Territoriales
description: Nicaraguan Institute of Territorial Studies (geodesy, cadastre, seismology, environment).

name: Instituto Nicaragüense de Turismo
description: Nicaraguan Tourism Institute.

name: Instituto Nicaragüense de Seguridad Social
description: Nicaraguan Social Security Institute.

name: Superintendencia de Bancos y de Otras Instituciones Financieras
description: Superintendency of Banks and Other Financial Institutions of Nicaragua (banking regulator).

name: Instituto Nicaragüense de Telecomunicaciones y Correos
description: Nicaraguan Institute of Telecommunications and Mail (regulator and postal operator).

name: Instituto Nacional Tecnológico
description: National Technological Institute of Nicaragua.

name: Instituto Nicaragüense de Pesca y Acuicultura
description: Nicaraguan Institute of Fisheries and Aquaculture.

name: Consejo Nacional de Universidades
description: National Council of Universities, coordinates the Nicaraguan university system (CNESU framework).

name: Instituto Nicaragüense de Deportes
description: Nicaraguan Institute of Sport.

name: Instituto de la Vivienda Urbana y Rural
description: Nicaraguan Institute of Urban and Rural Housing.

name: Ejército de Nicaragua
description: Armed forces of Nicaragua (army; the country has no separate navy/air force commands).

name: Policía Nacional de Nicaragua
description: National Police of Nicaragua.

name: Empresa Nicaragüense de Electricidad
description: State-owned Nicaraguan electricity company (ENEL).

name: Empresa Nicaragüense de Acueductos y Alcantarillados Sanitarios
description: State-owned water and sewerage utility of Nicaragua.

name: Empresa Nicaragüense de Alimentos Básicos
description: Government-owned enterprise devoted to internal trade, mostly grains (listed in Government of Nicaragua overview).

name: Empresa Nacional de Transmisión Eléctrica
description: National electricity transmission company operating the Nicaraguan grid (state-owned; public non-financial sector entity tracked by the central bank).

name: Empresa Portuaria Nacional
description: National Port Company of Nicaragua.

name: Empresa Administradora de Aeropuertos Internacionales
description: Administrative Company of International Airports of Nicaragua.

name: Corporación de Zonas Francas
aliases: Alba Latinoamericana de Zonas Francas (former name)
description: Corporation of Free Trade Zones of Nicaragua (CZF), listed in the Government of Nicaragua overview.

name: E Chamorro Industrial (Grupo El Chamorro)
description: Diversified Nicaraguan industrial group (food, sugar, rum, energy); ranked as top company by revenue in ZoomInfo's Nicaragua list.

name: Claro Nicaragua
description: Largest mobile/telecom operator in Nicaragua; among the country's top companies by revenue (ZoomInfo list).

name: Tip-Top
description: Nicaraguan fast food restaurant chain.

name: ECAMI
description: Nicaraguan company working in photovoltaic/renewable energy.

name: Joya de Nicaragua
description: Nicaraguan premium cigar manufacturer.

name: ESTESA
description: Nicaraguan electronic transaction/payment services company.

name: Gurú
description: Nicaraguan technology company (Wikidata-listed business).

name: Nicánima Estudios
description: Nicaraguan film/animation studio.

name: Roche (Nicaragua)
description: Nicaraguan arm of the Roche pharmaceutical group.

name: Servipro
description: Nicaraguan business-services company ranked first by revenue in ZoomInfo's Nicaragua business services list.

name: Banco Central de Nicaragua
description: Central bank of Nicaragua, issuer of the córdoba and regulator of the financial system alongside SIBOIF.

name: Banpro Grupo Promerica
description: Nicaragua's largest banking group (Banco de la Producción, Banpro); leading bank by total assets.

name: BAC Credomatic
description: Banco de América Central (BAC Credomatic), one of Nicaragua's largest banks, part of a regional Central American financial group.

name: Banco LAFISE Bancentro
description: Second-largest Nicaraguan bank by assets in 2019 (Statista); Euromoney Nicaragua Best Bank 2024 winner with assets reaching USD 2.28 billion; part of Grupo Lafise.

name: Banco de Finanzas
description: BDF, one of Nicaragua's largest private banks (listed among largest institutions by Rankings Latam 2025).

name: Banco Ficohsa Nicaragua
description: Nicaraguan subsidiary of Honduran banking group Ficohsa (group Wikidata Q5886178).

name: Avanz Financial Bank
description: Nicaraguan bank listed among the country's largest financial institutions.

name: Banco Intercontinental Nicaragua
description: Nicaraguan commercial bank (Interbank).

name: Centro Nicaragüense de Derechos Humanos
description: Nicaraguan human rights centre (CENIDH); its legal status was cancelled by Nicaraguan authorities and it continues work from abroad.

name: Asociación Madres de Abril
description: Association of mothers of people killed in the 2018 protests (AMAPREN).

name: Fondo Centroamericano de Mujeres
description: Central American Women's Fund (FCAM), a grantmaking foundation based in Managua supporting women's rights.

name: Fe y Alegría Nicaragua
description: Nicaraguan branch of the Fe y Alegría network of faith-based schools and education programmes.

name: World Vision Nicaragua
description: Nicaraguan operation of the Christian humanitarian NGO World Vision.

name: Aldeas Infantiles SOS Nicaragua
description: Nicaraguan branch of SOS Children's Villages.

name: Centro Nicaragüense de PEN
description: Nicaraguan PEN Centre, part of the international PEN association of writers.

name: Universidad Nacional Autónoma de Nicaragua (UNAN-Managua)
description: National Autonomous University of Nicaragua; the country's oldest higher-education institution, founded 1812 in León; main campus now in Managua.

name: UNAN León
aliases: National Autonomous University of Nicaragua at León
description: National Autonomous University of Nicaragua at León (split from UNAN-Managua campus system).

name: Universidad Centroamericana (UCA)
description: Jesuit-run private university in Managua; confiscated by the Nicaraguan government in August 2023.

name: Universidad Nacional de Ingeniería
description: National University of Engineering (UNI) in Managua.

name: INCAE Business School
aliases: Instituto Centroamericano de Administración de Empresas
description: Central American Institute of Business Administration (INCAE), international graduate business school with a campus in Managua.

name: Bluefields Indian and Caribbean University
description: Public university serving the Caribbean Coast autonomous regions (BICU).

name: Universidad de las Regiones Autónomas de la Costa Caribe Nicaragüense
description: University of the Autonomous Regions of the Nicaraguan Caribbean Coast.

name: Universidad del Valle de Nicaragua
description: University of the Valley Nicaragua (UNIVAL).

name: Universidad Politécnica de Nicaragua
description: Polytechnic University of Nicaragua (UPOLI).

name: Universidad Americana
description: Universidad Americana (UAM), private university in Managua.

name: Universidad Nicaragüense de Ciencia y Tecnología
description: Nicaraguan University of Science and Technology.

name: Universidad Católica Redemptoris Mater
description: Catholic university in Managua (UNICA), founded with support of the Legionaries of Christ.

name: Universidad Católica del Trópico Seco
description: Catholic University of the Dry Tropics (UCTS), based in Estelí.

name: Instituto de Historia de Nicaragua y Centroamérica
description: Institute of History of Nicaragua and Central America (IHNCA), research institute in Managua.

name: Thomas More Universitas
description: Private Nicaraguan university (Thomas More).

name: Ave Maria University-Latin American Campus
description: Latin American campus of Ave Maria University (USA) in San Marcos, Carazo.

name: La Prensa
description: Nicaraguan daily newspaper founded in 1926; harassed into exile, print stopped, online-only since 2021; offices seized by the government.

name: El Nuevo Diario
description: Nicaraguan newspaper (ceased print/publication in 2019 amid government pressure).

name: Confidencial
description: Investigative digital news outlet; driven into exile after 2018 and operates online from abroad (RSF and media monitors note its exile operation).

name: Televicentro (Canal 2)
description: Nicaraguan private television broadcaster operating Canal 2.

name: TN8
description: Televisora Nicaragüense S.A. (TN8), private open-television news channel.

name: Canal 6
description: State-linked public television channel; part of the media group controlled by the Ortega-Murillo family per RSF.

name: Canal 4 (Multinoticias)
description: State-linked television channel broadcasting the Multinoticias newscasts.

name: 100% Noticias
description: Private news channel; shut down by the Ortega government in December 2018, its director jailed; continues online from abroad.

name: Canal 8
description: TV channel under direct control of the Ortega-Murillo family per RSF.

name: Radio Ya
description: Radio station under direct control of the Ortega-Murillo family per RSF.

name: Radio Sandino
description: State-aligned radio station under control of the Ortega-Murillo family per RSF.

name: Frente Sandinista de Liberación Nacional
description: Sandinista National Liberation Front (FSLN), the ruling party led by Daniel Ortega; won 70+ seats in the 2021 National Assembly election.

name: Partido Liberal Constitucionalista
description: Constitutionalist Liberal Party (PLC), traditional liberal party; main opposition party holding seats.

name: Partido Conservador de Nicaragua
description: Conservative Party of Nicaragua (PCN), one of the country's two historic parties.

name: Alianza Liberal Nicaragüense
description: Nicaraguan Liberal Alliance (ALN), liberal alliance formed ahead of the 2006 election.

name: Movimiento Renovador Sandinista
description: Sandinista Renovation Movement (MRS), dissident-Sandinista party now known as Unamos.

name: YATAMA
description: Yapti Tasba Masraka Nanih Aslatakanka (YATAMA), indigenous party of the Caribbean Coast.

name: Ciudadanos por la Libertad
description: Citizens for Freedom (CxL), liberal opposition alliance formed around 2018-2019.

name: Partido Liberal Independiente
description: Independent Liberal Party (PLI).

name: Partido Socialista Nicaragüense
description: Nicaraguan Socialist Party (PSN).

name: Corte Centroamericana de Justicia
description: Central American Court of Justice, permanent judicial organ of the Central American Integration System (SICA), headquartered in Managua.
